newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re declines comment on M&G talk.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re declines comment on M&G talk.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co., rumoured to be interested in the Mercantile & General (M&G) reinsurance unit of Prudential Corp., restated that it would not comment on such rumours, but added that clarity over the situation would emerge in a few days.
"We cannot comment today," a Swiss Re spokesman said.
He added, however, that "there will be clarity over the situation in the next few days." He declined further comment.
Last week the were rumours in the market about Swiss Re planning a 1.5 billion sterling bid for M&G and the Financial Times reported that Swiss Re was believed to be a front runner to buy M&G.
Prudential has been planning to float M&G, but rumours about the possible sale to Swiss Re has sent Prudential's shares higher.
Analysts say Swiss Re would have no problems financing such an acquisition and a deal would be positive in the long run.
"The sector of life reinsurance offers continuous and very positive earnings prospects," said analyst Heinrich-Horst Wiemer Credit Suisse's CS Reseach.
Life reinsurance is less volatile than liability and catastrophe reinsurance and expanding into life reinsurance would be the right strategy for Swiss Re, Wiemer said.
